description: Restrained motion system. Motion communicates state changes, never decorates for its own sake. Every duration/easing pair below is disabled (collapsed to near-zero) under prefers-reduced-motion; see css/base.css.

rules.reduced_motion_policy: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, all durations collapse to 1ms and transform-based motion is replaced by opacity-only or instant state changes. No motion may be the sole indicator of a state change — it always accompanies a text/icon/color change.
